## 6. Commercial rule component-scrap

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f035-device-assembly-sow.md#6-commercial-rule-component-scrap

For excess component scrap, billability requires confirmed evidence of: scrap cause record; sponsor-caused component defect. An allowance of 1% of sponsor-issued units is included. Recorded loss beyond that allowance is priced at USD 177 per excess unit. All facts and approvals must concern supplier CPA1-F035, the billed service ID, invoice line and October 2026 service period. A record for another item provides no confirmation for this line.

## 1. Evidence escalation

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f035-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

This procedure governs device assembly evidence review for CPA1-F035 only. Conflicting sponsor and provider acceptance statuses for the same billed service item trigger evidence escalation; neither status is assumed to override the other. Reconciliation of the statuses is necessary before a billability conclusion. Unverified prerequisites require evidence review rather than assumed approval. Wrong-item records do not confirm the billed item. A signed exception is effective only when the SOW expressly permits it and CPA1-F035 sponsor commercial officer signs it before service, identifying the billed service ID. The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions.
